style.concept: cinematic 3D concept art, three-quarter view, single complete object centered, studio lighting, physically based materials, dark void background, Unreal Engine cinematic sculpt, no text, no watermark, not a 2D sprite, not top-down
style.icon: fantasy RPG game icon, Elona/Elin inspired, clear silhouette, centered subject, soft rim light, solid dark background, no text, no watermark, readable at small size
style.ui: Elin/Elona fantasy UI chrome, warm wood and brass, parchment accents, soft bevel, classic JRPG inventory aesthetic, clean edges, no text unless specified
style.portrait: Elona/Elin unique NPC portrait, soft watercolor anime illustration, head-and-shoulders bust, clean white/transparent background, soft lineart, gentle painted shading, no text, no watermark, no frame, no UI; output UN_crcc_{system}.png at 240x320 RGBA
style.spell_icon: fantasy RPG game spell icon, Elona/Elin inspired, single unique magical effect centered, clear silhouette, soft rim light, solid dark background, no text, no watermark, readable at small size, not a generic orb, not a stock fireball — each spell must look distinct
style.spell_concept: cinematic fantasy spell visualization, unique magical phenomenon as the subject, dramatic lighting, physically based materials, dark void background, Unreal Engine cinematic, no text, no watermark — complex art that clearly depicts THIS spell only, never a shared school emblem
